scripts.validate: pnpm validate:agentops && pnpm validate:identity && pnpm validate:domains && pnpm validate:package-identity && pnpm validate:brand-neutrality && pnpm validate:branding-vnext && pnpm validate:boundaries && pnpm validate:bundles && pnpm validate:release && pnpm validate:release-contracts
scripts.validate:boundaries: node scripts/check-ui-boundaries.mjs && pnpm --dir packages/ui run validate:boundaries
scripts.deploy:docs:prod: pnpm guard:release:mutation && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_VERSION" && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_GIT_SHA" && test -n "$PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME" && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui-docs run build && pnpm --dir apps/docs exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:showcase-admin:prod: pnpm guard:release:mutation && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui-showcase-admin run build:cloudflare:production && pnpm --dir apps/showcase-admin exec wrangler deploy
scripts.build:packages:release: pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/brand-contract run build && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui run build && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/brand-runtime run build && pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/brand-studio run build
scripts.publish:packages:verify: pnpm guard:release:mutation && node scripts/release/verify-package-dists.ts && pnpm pack:packages
scripts.smoke:showcase:local: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @lemn-ltd/ui-showcase run cf:build && node scripts/release/showcase-assets-smoke.ts
scripts.release: pnpm release:preflight && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build:packages:release && pnpm publish:packages:release
